source_texts.locator: CP1252 line5314, Trikon Shodana; 5317–21, Ekadhipatya Shodana
source_texts.summary: Translation describes subtraction in Trikona ambiguously as subtracting from largest; more granular paired-sign conditional rules are difficult and incomplete.
four trines, subtract min from all three, if any zero no reduction, all-equal zero; following stage Ekadhipatya.
Pairs of signs sharing lords, with different transformations depending on planetary occupancy, equality and unequal values. Multiple clauses require ordering and source edition/semantic review.

trikona_shodana.confidence: HIGH for the basic Sanskrit relative reduction as described; no unique ephemeris involved
trikona_shodana.input: Twelve unsigned integer favorable Rekha counts for ONE planet-target Aṣṭakavarga, before Ekadhipatya.
trikona_shodana.algorithm: Process each disjoint trine independently. If any of the three counts is zero, leave the triple unchanged. Otherwise subtract its minimum from each of the three counts; equality reduces all to zero.
trikona_shodana.reference_sanskrit_short: त्रिकोणेषु च यन्न्यूनं तत्तुल्यं त्रिषु शोधयेत्
trikona_shodana.boundary_conditions: No negative input or output; equality of all inputs yields three zeros; zero initial input leaves triple unchanged.

small_math_validation_examples.reason: any zero in trine leaves it unchanged
two equal minima yield two zeros

ekadhipatya_shodana.stage_order: After trine reduction and before Pinda
certain_clauses: Both signs occupied by planets -> no reduction (68.3 first line).
Equal numbers in sign with planet and partner empty -> empty sign loses its number (68.5).
Single Sun/Moon signs Cancer and Leo not paired for two-sign owner stage (68.6).
unresolved_clauses: How exactly to transform different unequal 2-sign counts when occupied sign has fewer/further points, versus unoccupied sign.
Meaning of abandonment of all in Sanskrit 68.4 in context: all points in unoccupied sign? all correction? The provided auto translation is not unambiguous.
Case both empty and equal sign counts; literal wording might zero both, but preserve verse context and boundary state first.

stages: Input favorable Bindu/Rekha arrays (Saturn sixth original Sanskrit correction as separate variant).
